elsewhere.note: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.
“How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me…
Yahweh answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.
